crossRefs.note: who also made us sufficient as servants of a new covenant, not of the letter, but of the Spirit. For the letter kills…
It is the spirit who gives life. The flesh profits nothing. The words that I speak to you are spirit, and are life.
So also it is written, “The first man, Adam, became a living soul.” The last Adam became a life-giving spirit.
Restore to me the joy of your salvation. Uphold me with a willing spirit.
The Lord Yahweh’s Spirit is on me, because Yahweh has anointed me to preach good news to the humble. He has sent me to…
For the law of the Spirit of life in Christ Jesus made me free from the law of sin and of death.
For you didn’t receive the spirit of bondage again to fear, but you received the Spirit of adoption, by whom we cry…
The Spirit himself testifies with our spirit that we are children of God;
And because you are children, God sent out the Spirit of his Son into your hearts, crying, “Abba, Father!”
For God didn’t give us a spirit of fear, but of power, love, and self-control.
